rationale: After 66 minutes in the trade, SWK has failed to test the $122.65 target and just printed a sharp 1-minute bearish breakdown bar on a 5x volume spike (23,840 shares), slicing below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($121.40). With momentum rolling over and price giving back nearly all of its 0.62% maximum favorable excursion, closing at market locks in the remaining gain and avoids a likely drop to the $120.15 invalidation level. Flipping to short is avoided due to the strong earnings catalyst, 5.45x relative volume, and broad market strength (SPY +1.70%).
